description.value: Fruit World is a large outdoor farm market spanning over 4,000 square feet, situated directly adjacent to the Trans-Canada Highway in Sicamous at the northern tip of the Okanagan Valley — a natural resupply point for cyclists on the Vancouver–Calgary corridor. Entering its 20th season in 2026, it specializes in bulk local and exotic fresh fruit and vegetables sourced directly from Okanagan farms, alongside specialty snacks, preserves, juices, and ciders. The shaded outdoor market layout and easy highway access in both directions make it a convenient and pleasant stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is the primary evidence source and provides clear business details: an outdoor seasonal farm market at 1330 Maier Road, Sicamous BC, on the Trans-Canada Highway, open late May through early October. The site confirms phone (250-836-5555) and address absent from OSM tags, and describes an extensive selection of local fruit, vegetables, snacks, preserves, and drinks — confirming basic groceries. No bike-specific amenities (parking, racks, water refill, washrooms, ice, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone — both sourced from website only.
Seasonal operation only (late May to early October); cyclists planning outside this window will find it closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established seasonal farm market on the Trans-Canada Highway in Sicamous, directly relevant to touring cyclists needing fresh fruit and produce resupply on a major cycling corridor.
